To solve this, we can use the Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion.  Let: *   $F$ = set of students who play football ($|F| = 18$) *   $T$ = set of students who play tennis ($|T| = 15$) *   $N$ = total number of students ($30$) *   Neither = students in neither sport ($6$)  Therefore, the number of students who play at least one sport is: $N - \text{Neither} = 30 - 6 = 24$.  The formula for the union of two sets is: $|F \cup T| = |F| + |T| - |F \cap T|$  Where $|F \cap T|$ is the number of students who play both.
